name: Nexus Agent Core
description: Nexus Agent Core. Stage 1: the Task module (tools nexus_task_*, RPC nexus.task.*, open-Task prompt list). Stage 2: decisions, grants and executions with a fake provider (tools nexus_action_* / nexus_decision_request, RPC nexus.decision.* / nexus.execution.* / nexus.grant.*). Stage 3: a Claim / Evidence ledger with completion gating (tools nexus_claim_add / nexus_evidence_add / nexus_claim_verify, RPC nexus.claim.*). Stage 4: a Preference Store (tools nexus_preference_*, RPC nexus.preference.*), a read-only Control UI tab, and a Watcher for scheduled re-checks (tools nexus_watch_*, RPC nexus.watch.*). Stage 5: a personal file vault (tools nexus_file_*, RPC nexus.vault.*). All off by default. Stage 0 runtime spikes remain behind spikesEnabled (see nexus-agent-core-design.md section 13).

tasksEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 1 Task module: nexus_task_* tools (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.task.* gateway methods, the open-Task prompt list and the nexus.sqlite store. Off by default.

decisionsEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 2 decision module (needs tasksEnabled): nexus_action_prepare / nexus_action_authorize / nexus_decision_request / nexus_action_commit (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.decision.* / nexus.execution.* / nexus.grant.* gateway methods, and a FAKE provider. Off by default.

claimsEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 3 Claim / Evidence ledger (needs decisionsEnabled): nexus_claim_add / nexus_evidence_add / nexus_claim_verify (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.claim.* gateway methods, completion gating for nexus_task_update(succeeded) and execution-result claims. Off by default.

evidenceBlobsEnabled.description: Enable Stage 3 evidence bytes (needs claimsEnabled): the operator upload RPC nexus.evidence.upload / .link and `blob` refs for nexus_evidence_add, stored through the plugin blob store with reservations, soft quotas and reclaim. Off by default.

preferencesEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 4 Preference Store (needs tasksEnabled; confirming a value as the user's stated preference also needs decisionsEnabled): nexus_preference_get / nexus_preference_set / nexus_preference_confirm (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow) and nexus.preference.* gateway methods. A preference is a default, never authority. Off by default.

watchersEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 4 Watcher (needs claimsEnabled): nexus_watch_create / nexus_watch_cancel / nexus_watch_report (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.watch.* gateway methods, and background re-check turns scheduled through the host cron service. A re-check turn can only read and attach evidence. Off by default.

watcherExtraTools.description: Extra read-only tools a re-check turn may use besides the Nexus ones. Only web_fetch and web_search are accepted: a re-check turn reads untrusted content, so the list is fixed by the plugin, not open to other tool names.

evidenceTaskQuotaBytes.description: Soft evidence quota per Task in bytes (default 200 MB). Overflow fails closed and creates an R0 notice decision.

evidenceOwnerQuotaBytes.description: Soft evidence quota per owner in bytes, counted over physical objects (default 400 MB). The SDK's own ceiling is 512 MB for the whole plugin.

evidenceMaxUploadBytes.description: Largest single piece of evidence in bytes (default 16 MB; the SDK allows 100 MB). Uploads travel base64-encoded in one RPC frame, so keep it below the gateway payload limit.

evidenceWriterLeaseMs.description: Writer lease for an evidence write in flight. Expiry only allows reclaim to claim the object; it never proves the write stopped.

evidenceReservationTtlMs.description: How long an unsettled reservation counts against the quota before reclaim may claim it. Lower it only for testing.

evidenceIncarnationGoneEnabled.description: Enable the `incarnation_gone` absence-proof reason (DESIGN 9.5.1): a new gateway start marks earlier process rows with a different boot id as gone, which lets purge and GC treat their unfinished blob writes as settled. Only enable it after the checklist holds: readable boot id, ONE gateway per state directory, no mis-marking on same-process reload, and an observed crash-restart. Off by default.

fakeProviderIdempotent.description: Stage 2 fake provider: honour the provider idempotency key (retries are safe). Set false to exercise the 'no idempotency support, reconcile only' path.

fakeProviderMode.description: Stage 2 fake provider failure injection: reject = provider declines; drop_after_success = effect happens but the connection drops (execution becomes unknown); drop_before_send = nothing happens and the connection drops.

coreApprovalEnabled.description: Attach an optional core approval card to nexus_decision_request on user turns. The Nexus decision page (nexus.decision.*) is always the primary path.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the optional core approval card. Lower it (e.g. 120000) if the host rejects timeouts above 2 minutes.

ownerId.description: MVP owner id placeholder (DESIGN section 5). Not a security boundary. Defaults to "local".

spikesEnabled.description: Register the Stage 0 spike probes (gateway methods nexus.spike.*, tool nexus_spike_probe, probe service). Off by default so the plugin is inert.

spikeStopDelayMs.description: Spike 3 item 4: delay the probe service stop() by this many ms to observe the reload stop timeout.

spikeStartFailOnce.description: Spike 3 item 4: make the first probe service start() throw once to observe start-failure retry.

vaultEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 5 personal file vault (needs tasksEnabled): nexus_file_search / nexus_file_get (and nexus_file_attach when evidence bytes are on) as optional tools (allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.vault.* gateway methods, and a file store next to nexus.sqlite. Files are kept on this computer only. Off by default.

vaultOwnerQuotaBytes.description: Soft vault quota per owner in bytes, counted over physical objects plus unsettled reservations (default 5 GB).

vaultMaxFileBytes.description: Largest single vault file in bytes (default 100 MB). An RPC upload is additionally capped at 16 MB; larger files come in through nexus.vault.importPath.

vaultInboxRetentionDays.description: Days an unreviewed inbox file waits before it is discarded (default 30).

vaultTrashRetentionDays.description: Days a trashed file stays restorable before it is permanently purged (default 30).

vaultImportRoots.description: Folders nexus.vault.importPath may read from. Default: Downloads and Documents in the user's home folder. Credential folders and the Nexus state folder are always refused.

vaultMinFreeBytes.description: Refuse a vault write when the disk would drop below this many free bytes (default 1 GB). The disk is shared with the user.

vaultReservationRetentionDays.description: Days settled write reservations are kept for diagnosis before they are pruned (default 7).

vaultTombstoneRetentionDays.description: Days a deleted object's tombstone is kept so a late writer can still be recognised (default 7).

vaultPurgeReceiptHashRetentionDays.description: Days a purge receipt keeps the content hashes of the purged file; afterwards only counts and times remain (default 90).

vaultExtractEnabled.description: Extract searchable text from text-class files (txt, md, csv, json, html, code) and allow content search (default true under vaultEnabled). Sensitive files are never extracted. The text stays on this computer; the Agent only learns which files match, never what they say.

vaultHttpUploadEnabled.description: Offer the resumable chunked upload route /plugins/nexus-agent-core/vault-upload (gateway auth, operator.write scope; at most 4 open uploads, 24 h to finish) for large files and phones. Default true under vaultEnabled.

vaultExtractMaxBytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes are not extracted (default 5 MiB).

vaultExtractMaxChars.description: Characters indexed per file; the rest is dropped and the file is marked truncated (default 2,000,000).
